in_telugu.meaning: జ్ఞానం మరియు జ్యోతిష్టం ద్వారా ప్రకాశించిన వ్యక్తి

in_marathi.name: Jyotishman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Astrology
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyotishman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the words 'Jyoti' meaning 'light' and 'man' meaning 'one who controls'. Jyotishman signifies the one who controls the light of astrology.

in_bengali.name: Jyotishman

in_bengali.long_meaning: Jyotishman একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the words 'Jyoti' meaning 'light' and 'man' meaning 'one who controls'. Jyotishman signifies the one who controls the light of astrology.
